source_summary: Panoramic Chinese landscape handscroll with misty lake at left, clustered waterside village and willows in the middle, steep rocky mountains and pine groves rising behind, scholar/traveler figures with animals along the lower path, and a large garden-pavilion compound with waterfall and dense trees on the right.

motifs.name: left_lake_boat
motifs.description: Small narrow boat on the lower-left lake surface with a seated boatman and low cargo forms, isolated from the blank surrounding water.
must_preserve: thin dark hull line and upturned prow/stern
tiny seated figure and pole/oar gesture
small rounded cargo marks inside the boat
faint horizontal water wash around the boat

motifs.name: misty_lakeside_hamlet
motifs.description: Left-middle shoreline settlement with bare trees, willow clumps, a small red-roofed building, distant low shore, and soft lake mist.
must_preserve: fine ink outlines of leaning bare branches
soft gray-green wash on willow foliage
small red color accent on the roof near the water
pale horizontal shoreline strokes fading into mist
tiny distant structures and boat-like marks along the far bank

motifs.name: central_peak_range
motifs.description: Central background mountain mass with jagged peak, sloping ridges, pale cliff faces, and sparse summit trees.
must_preserve: angular ridge outlines and broken contour strokes
dry-brush rock texture on the cliff faces
pale beige-gray wash transitions on slopes
small dark tree silhouettes along ridges
mist-softened lower mountain edge

motifs.name: willow_pavilion_village
motifs.description: Central lower village area with clustered thatched and tiled pavilions, drooping willows, footpaths, rocks, and a low red-railed bridge or walkway.
must_preserve: delicate roof geometry on small pavilions
drooping willow foliage rendered with soft vertical strokes
dark twisting trunks and exposed branch linework
low red railing accent near the bottom center
scattered ink rocks and path texture at ground level

motifs.name: pine_cliff_slope
motifs.description: Middle-right rocky hillside with tall pines, blue-green pine needle clusters, exposed trunks, and pale cliff wash behind.
must_preserve: blue-green clustered pine needle dabs
sinuous brown trunks and branching structure
dry textured rock strokes on the sloping cliff
small ledges and path-like breaks in the rock
misty pale wash separating trees from mountain face

motifs.name: travelers_with_animals
motifs.description: Lower center-right path group of small human figures, animals, and attendants crossing open ground below the cliffs.
must_preserve: tiny robe outlines and upright figure gestures
animal bodies and legs drawn with fine dark strokes
small attendant carrying object or bundle
light ground wash around the procession
spacing between figures showing movement along the path

motifs.name: right_garden_pavilions_waterfall
motifs.description: Right-side garden compound with upper and lower pavilions, tiled roofs, red railings, enclosing wall, dense trees, and a narrow waterfall descending from the cliff behind.
must_preserve: crisp tiled roof grids and upturned eaves
red railing and architectural accent lines
thin vertical waterfall streaks against the cliff
dense stippled foliage around the buildings
pale wall and gateway geometry along the lower compound

motifs.name: right_rock_shrub_cluster
motifs.description: Far-right foreground rocky outcrop with dark crag lines, dense shrubs, bamboo-like foliage, and small red blossoms or berries.
must_preserve: dark angular rock contours and dry-brush crevices
layered shrub masses with fine leaf dots
small red floral or berry accents
thin twig and bamboo-like linework
contrast between heavy foreground ink and pale misty ground

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
